name: Martyr's Retribution

perks.name: Volatile Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon is optimized for an especially explosive payload.
  •  Greatly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Confined Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch parameters are particularly stable.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Countermass
perks.desc:
This weapon is weighted for vertical recoil.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Hard Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is optimized for projectile speed.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Linear Compensator
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is well-balanced.
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Quick Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's barrel provides faster projectiles and much faster aiming.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Increases projectile speed

perks.name: Smart Drift Control
perks.desc:
This barrel is broadly optimized for firing control.
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed

perks.name: High-Velocity Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Implosion Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles travel faster and have a controlled explosion.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Decreases blast radius

perks.name: Proximity Grenades
perks.desc: Grenades fired from this weapon have increased proximity detection but a decreased blast radius.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.desc: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Heal Clip
perks.desc: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Genesis
perks.desc: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon fills its magazine from reserves. Energy weapons regenerate ammo on hit when matching the damage type to the combatant's shield.

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.desc: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Strategist
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon generate class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.desc:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.desc: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Cast No Shadows
perks.desc: Dealing melee damage increases this weapon's handling and loads a small amount of ammo from reserves.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 115 from 6 September 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6axWXT6NCn4jZVuRkCTfiu?si=72aafbad8138409a) with @ImpetusAlways, @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing minor enemies in end-game content, particularly with a solar build. Martyr's Retribution is back from the great sunsetting and provides an avenue for new players to obtain a solid solar wave-frame grenade launcher. Its stats are decent at base - 73 Velocity, 65 Handling which equates to 0.37s ready, 0.38s ADS speed and 0.34s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 63 is a 2.16s reload. Blast Radius is probably the most important barrel perk stat to boost - you're firing at your feet or nearby mostly, so you want the wave as wide and long as possible. High Velocity Rounds is the best magazine perk, boosting Velocity and Reload Speed. In the first trait perk slot, Field Prep takes the total ammo to its maximum of 25, without the need for reserves mods, and speeds up reloads to 1.44s when procced, but Auto-Loading Holster means you're always ready to shoot or Envious Assassin overflows the magazine to get up to 3 in the mag after 11 kills with other weapons. Pair that with Incandescent in the second for add clearing, synergising with solar scorch and ignition verbs through fragments in your build. The Cast No Shadows origin trait is great for reloading and boosting handling for a short time on dealing melee damage. Recommended MW: Blast Radius, with a Quick Access Sling mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Martyr's Retribution returns. One of my favorite weapons from Season of the Dawn, does it stand up to current weapons? In short. Yes. Auto-Loading Holster with Incandescent for clearing rooms similar to Chain Reaction. If you prefer solar synergy then this is your go-to." Recommended MW: Blast Radius.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Martyr's has absolutely nothing going for it in the fourth column. No Disruption Break for starting engagements, it does have Incandescent for finishing engagements but that's a weird play style as you wouldn't really be able to build momentum off of kills." Recommended MW: Velocity.

Mercules904 (PvP): "A very interesting intrinsic perk that I personally find to be a little bit like using a Sunbreaker's Thermite grenade, and I kinda like the utility of it. The hit box for the solar blast is relatively forgiving, and I don't have much issue hitting people, even when they were slightly behind cover."
